use_when: 文件预览
文件加速打开
缓存加速

如何预览图片、视频、音频、文本和HTML文件？
如何预览PDF和Office文档（doc/xls/ppt）？

如何使用通用文件缓存加速功能优化文件浏览性能？

文件预览支持哪些文件格式？
预览失败时如何排查问题？
当应用需要快速预览各类文件内容时使用本Kit的文件预览功能
支持多种文件格式的一键预览，无需打开第三方应用即可查看文件内容，适合文件管理器、邮件客户端等需要浏览多种类型文件的场景
当需要优化文件打开速度时使用本Kit的文件打开加速和缓存加速功能
文件打开加速通过预加载机制缩短大文件打开时间，通用文件缓存加速通过磁盘缓存减少重复解码开销，适合文档编辑器、图片浏览器等频繁打开文件的场景
在应用内直接打开并查看附件内容，不跳转第三方应用 / Open and view attachments inside the app without switching to a third-party app
集成文档预览页来显示 PDF、Word、Excel 和 PPT 文件 / Integrate a document preview page to display PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
实现图片、音频、视频和文本文件的统一预览入口 / Implement a unified preview entry for images, audio, video, and text files
点击文件列表后秒开预览，减少用户等待时间 / Open file previews instantly from a file list to reduce user wait time
为网盘或文件管理器接入多格式文件浏览能力 / Add multi-format file browsing to a cloud drive or file manager app
对常看文件做预加载和缓存，加快再次打开速度 / Preload and cache frequently viewed files to speed up reopening
监听文件预热或预加载进度并更新界面状态 / Listen for file warm-up or preload progress and update the UI state
在聊天或邮件场景中预览收到的文档和媒体文件 / Preview received documents and media files in chat or email scenarios
用文件预览能力展示本地文件和下载后的内容 / Use file preview capability to display local files and downloaded content
实现 HTML 和纯文本内容的快速查看页面 / Implement a fast viewer page for HTML and plain text content
管理预览缓存文件，平衡打开速度和存储占用 / Manage preview cache files to balance open speed and storage usage
接入文件打开加速能力，优化大文件首屏展示时间 / Integrate file open acceleration to improve first-screen display time for large files
do_not_use_when: 需求是安全保存密码、令牌、凭据等短敏感数据，并需要AES256-GCM加密、属主/群组访问控制或用户认证授权，应改用 asset-store-kit / The task is to securely store short sensitive data like passwords, tokens, or credentials with AES256-GCM encryption, owner/group access control, or user authentication; use asset-store-kit instead

需求是解析txt、epub、mobi、azw、azw3电子书，进行排版、分页或阅读器交互构建，应改用 reader-kit / The requirement is to parse txt, epub, mobi, azw, or azw3 e-books and provide layout, pagination, or reader interactions; use reader-kit instead

需求是实现跨应用数据共享、标准化数据定义，或让多设备之间的数据一致分发，应改用 arkdata / The requirement is to enable cross-application data sharing, standardized data definitions, or consistent data distribution across devices; use arkdata instead
preconditions: 目标设备与能力受支持：文件预览仅支持中国境内的 Phone、Tablet、2in1，文件打开加速仅支持 2in1 / The target device and capability are supported: file preview is only supported in mainland China on Phone, Tablet, and 2in1, while file open acceleration is only supported on 2in1
待打开文件为 Kit 支持的格式，且若为 Office 文档预览需设备具备 WPS 相关能力 / The file type is supported by the Kit, and Office document preview requires WPS-related capability on the device
应用已拿到可读取目标文件的有效 URI 或文件路径访问权限，跨应用文档 URI 需已授权 / The app has a valid URI or file-path read permission for the target file, and cross-app document URIs must already be authorized
inputs: 目标文件 URI 或文件路径 / target file URI or file path
文件 MIME 类型或扩展名 / file MIME type or extension
预览或加速模式配置 / preview or acceleration mode configuration
预加载状态监听器或回调 / preload status listener or callback
outputs: 文件预览窗口/页面（由 openPreview 拉起的系统预览界面） / File preview window/page (system preview UI launched by openPreview)
openPreview 调用完成结果或错误对象（Promise<void> / BusinessError） / openPreview completion result or error object (Promise<void> / BusinessError)
文件预加载状态回调数据（预加载中、完成、失败等状态） / File preload status callback data (loading, completed, failed, etc.)
文件打开加速产生的预加载数据/加速缓存 / Preloaded data or acceleration cache produced for faster file opening
通用文件缓存加速产生的解码数据磁盘缓存 / Decoded-data disk cache produced by general file cache acceleration

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入 Preview Kit 的文件预览或文件打开加速相关调用，而不是仅停留在占位说明 / The code integrates Preview Kit file preview or file-open acceleration calls rather than only placeholder comments
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add concrete Preview Kit API usage for opening preview or enabling file preload/cache acceleration, instead of just describing it in comments or prose?

postconditions.statement: 目标文件标识被传入相关调用，并包含对 URI/路径有效性的处理或失败分支 / The target file identifier is passed into the relevant call, with handling for URI/path validity or a failure branch
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there a real file URI/path argument wired into the Preview Kit call and some validation, exception handling, or error callback for invalid or failed preview/open?

postconditions.statement: 若实现文件打开加速，则代码中包含预加载状态监听或结果处理逻辑 / If file-open acceleration is implemented, the code includes preload status monitoring or result handling logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits add file open acceleration, do they also add a listener, callback, or explicit handling for preload status or completion/failure results?
